t: To avoid duplication of efforts, it shall be the responsibility of the Secretary to consult and coordinate with the Attorney General and such other Federal officers as are charged with responsibilities in the area of combating juvenile delinquency or crime in general.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that "consult and coordinate" signals participation. But the only parties consulted are the Attorney General and other Federal officers, all of whom are inside the federal government. Intra-government coordination does not cross the federal boundary, so no outside party is involved in a federal decision.
fable.s: consult and coordinate with the Attorney General and such other Federal officers as are charged with responsibilities in the area of combating juvenile delinquency or crime in general

qwen_block.w: The section requires consultation and coordination between federal officials (the Secretary, the Attorney General, and other Federal officers). Since all parties involved are inside the federal government, this constitutes intra-governmental coordination, not participation by outside parties.
qwen_block.s: it shall be the responsibility of the Secretary to consult and coordinate with the Attorney General and such other Federal officers

opus.w: The section requires consultation and coordination only between the Secretary, the Attorney General and other Federal officers. That is coordination within the government, which the definition excludes. The words 'consult and coordinate' look like participation, but no state, tribe, expert, company or member of the public is involved.
opus.s: it shall be the responsibility of the Secretary to consult and coordinate with the Attorney General and such other Federal officers as are charged with responsibilities in the area of combating juvenile delinquency or crime in general
opus.b: The obvious wrong reading is "Yes", because the section uses the words "consult and coordinate." That fails the boundary test: the only parties named are the Secretary, the Attorney General and other Federal officers. Everyone involved is inside the federal government, so there is no outside participation.

qwen_chat.w: The section requires the Secretary to consult and coordinate with the Attorney General and other Federal officers. Since all these actors are inside the federal government, this constitutes intra-governmental coordination, not participation with outside parties. The definition explicitly excludes consultation between federal agencies or officials.
qwen_chat.s: it shall be the responsibility of the Secretary to consult and coordinate with the Attorney General and such other Federal officers as are charged with responsibilities in the area of combating juvenile delinquency or crime in general.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might think that "consult and coordinate" implies participation because it involves interaction. However, the definition explicitly states that consultation or coordination *between* federal agencies or federal officials (e.g., the Secretary and the Attorney General) is intra-government coordination and does not count as participation. The actors involved are all inside the federal government.
